parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, s.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN compound_structures s ON s.molregno = m.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = m.molregno WHERE m.max_phase = 4 AND di.efo_id IS NOT NULL AND di.efo_term IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, s.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind
